details:
Currently, Contacts are the only way to send information from one avatar to another. However, each Contact Sender can only send a binary state depending on its Tags, meaning that you need a separate Contact Sender for every independent piece of information you want to transmit. This quickly becomes inefficient when creating complex systems.

For that reason I believe it would be very useful to add features like:

- Toggleable Tags: Allow each Tag to be enabled or disabled independently, so the Contact Sender can choose which Tags to transmit.

- Parameter Transmission: Allow contacts to send values, such as integers or floats, instead of only indicating that there is a contact.

Imagine you want an elemental system that can switch between water, earth, fire, and air, and you want other avatars to react to it. Instead of requiring four independent Contact Senders for each element, a single one could use its Tags to change between them too.

Being able to transmit Parameters would take this even further, allowing avatars to share specific information and opening up many more possibilities for interactive assets that require more specific communication between avatars. Also allowing more communication between avatars and worlds, as well as with shaders, now that we have Material Contacts.

Ideally, each Tag could also carry its own Parameter, allowing a single Contact Sender to transmit multiple values. Since we already have parameters such as "{parameter}_CollisionTag_{tag}" to detect individual Tags through the same Contact Receiver, it could be possible to get every value using the same one too.

I know there's much more potential in Contact Senders than just a limited, predetermined information.
title: Allow Contact Senders to Toggle Tags and Send Parameters
